summary: A primitive (Hermite) basis change of x_f·y, block triangular for flagOrder, is an adapted basis.

steps.claim: x_f·y is invertible, so by IsValuationPair.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul (for (𝔸_f, Ô) and the weights flagOrder) there is an invertible b, block upper triangular for flagOrder, with (x_f y)·b primitive (H).
Take β_i = b(e(i), e(i)): these diagonal entries are units, since (b·b⁻¹)_{ii} = b_{ii}(b⁻¹)_{ii} = 1 (mul_apply_string_of_blockTriangular); b is block triangular by H.
steps.lean: ⟨(.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ <| by rw [← mul_apply_string_of_blockTriangular H.1 _ ·, b.3] <;> aesop), H.1,

steps.claim: The lattice condition follows from primitivity (isPrimitiveMatrix_iff), the diagonal condition by definition.
